### ✨ Stella Sora Mod Menu (v2.0.0)
Pro Glass UI Mod Menu for **Stella Sora** by **m0hammed** (`@m0hmm3d`) — supports both **Rootless (`arm64`)** and **RootHide (`arm64e`)**.

### 🔥 Mod Features
- **Activate Pro God Preset** — Enables God Mode & 1-Hit Kill in 1 tap
- **God Mode (Invincible)** — Maxes HP/DEF & 100% all-type damage reduction
- **HP Multiplier (`1x – 50x`)** — Scales character Max HP & floor HP
- **Defense Multiplier (`1x – 50x`)** — Multiplies character DEF stat
- **1-Hit Kill Enemies** — Maxes ATK, Final DMG, Crit Rate & 100% DEF Ignore
- **Damage Multiplier (`1x – 100x`)** — Adds Final DMG% multiplier
- **Attack Stat Multiplier (`1x – 50x`)** — Multiplies character base ATK stat
- **Instant Full Heal Party** — Restores active party HP to 100% max

### 🛡️ Protection
- **1-User License**: Each token locks automatically to the first device that activates it.
